correctness.rationale: Explicit anchor-unimodular normalization and graph-diameter assumptions; single-star range-density computation gives V=N+2m/(N-m). Positive-range exceptional strata are indexed by a unique deleted star; the rest of the vertices must lie in a common interval of length under 1, so other deleted-edge inequalities cannot contribute. Disjoint strata imply exact additivity. Strict superadditivity, discrete convexity and vertex-count budget prove both unique extremal patterns. Eleven exact independent Ehrhart computations agree. Boundary N>=3 and M<=N-2 checked; finite checks do not purport to prove infinite theorem.
